evals.name: notify-owner-saga
evals.expected_output: Classifies notify_owner as an automation slice because pet_registered belongs to the internal clinic context. Creates lib/slices/notify_owner/ (not lib/automation/). Generates the command code in lib/slices/notify_owner/send_owner_notification/ with the state-change code shapes (command, state, errors, decider, repository, aggregate, service; no DTO, handler, or module), and the to-do read model in lib/slices/notify_owner/pets_needing_notification/ with the state-view code shapes (query, state, View that folds PetRegisteredEvent, repository, service). saga.dart reacts to the PetsNeedingNotification read-model state and imports the command class from send_owner_notification/command.dart; publisher.dart sends each command to the service of that subfolder; service.dart (createSagaManager), handler.dart, module.dart. Imports no other slice. Tests in test/slices/notify_owner/ assert the commands that the saga sends.

evals.name: import-partner-translation
evals.expected_output: Classifies import_partner_pet as a translation slice because pet_received belongs to the partner context with external = true. Creates lib/slices/import_partner_pet/ (not lib/translation/) with the command code in lib/slices/import_partner_pet/import_pet/, generated with the state-change code shapes before the processor. Adds dto.dart, mapper.dart (partner DTO to internal values), saga.dart (sends ImportPetCommand), handler.dart, module.dart, and codec.dart only if the boundary needs one. ExternalPetImportedEvent stays in lib/bounded_contexts/clinic/. No business decisions in the mapper. Tests in test/slices/import_partner_pet/ cover DTO parsing, mapping, and codec round trips.

evals.name: record-deposit-dispatch-keys
evals.expected_output: Classifies record_deposit as a translation slice because payment_received belongs to the external payments context. Creates lib/slices/record_deposit/ (not lib/translation/), with the command code in lib/slices/record_deposit/record_deposit/. Because deposit_recorded is a given event that the processor does not consume and payment_reference is a deduplication key, generates processor_state.dart with a View that folds DepositRecordedEvent into the recorded payment references; the saga sends no command for a recorded reference. Because booking_reference is a correlation key and no field_source maps it to booking_id, generates a lookup port in port.dart with an in-memory adapter and reports the port to the user. The saga maps payment_reference with the stated field_source, and reports the inferred mappings for amount and booking_id. Tests in test/slices/record_deposit/: payment_becomes_deposit asserts that the saga sends RecordDepositCommand; repeated_payment_is_ignored asserts that the saga sends no RecordDepositCommand; tests are grouped by case (happy_path, business_duplicate).

evals.name: todo-list-view-form
evals.expected_output: Classifies the workflow as an automation slice (internal events only) in lib/slices/request_appointment_reminder/. Generates the to-do list in lib/slices/request_appointment_reminder/appointments_needing_reminder/ (View: appointment_added adds an item, appointment_reminder_requested removes it; initial state is the empty list) and the command code in lib/slices/request_appointment_reminder/request_reminder/. saga.dart reacts to the to-do read-model state and sends one RequestReminderCommand for each item. The three scenarios without a when step are view form scenarios: View tests in test/slices/request_appointment_reminder/appointments_needing_reminder/; empty_history checks the initial state; expect_empty_list expects no items. The action form scenario uses a read-model state fixture, runs the saga, and runs the sent command through the request_reminder decider to compare with the then event.
